benchmark.name: single-llm-baseline-vs-multi-agent
benchmark.description: Synthetic, non-production contract review benchmark for deterministic regression testing. It is not a legal dataset and does not measure legal correctness.

predictions.contract_quote: The vendor's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited for any direct or indirect damages.
predictions.policy_quote: Company requires all vendor contracts to cap aggregate liability at twelve (12) months of fees paid under the agreement. Unlimited or uncapped liability is not permitted.
predictions.explanation: The contract contains unlimited liability while the active policy requires a cap of 12 months of fees. This requires human review against the policy.
predictions.suggested_question: Can liability be capped in line with the active policy before signature?

predictions.contract_quote: Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience with fifteen (15) days' prior written notice.
predictions.policy_quote: Vendor agreements must provide at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice before termination for convenience.
predictions.explanation: The contract permits termination on 15 days' notice, while the active policy requires at least 30 days' notice.
predictions.suggested_question: Can the termination notice period be increased from 15 to 30 days?

predictions.contract_quote: Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days of receipt.
predictions.policy_quote: All vendor invoices must be paid within thirty (30) days of receipt.
predictions.explanation: The contract allows 60 days to pay, while the active policy requires payment within 30 days.
predictions.suggested_question: Can the payment period be shortened from 60 to 30 days?

limitations: The dataset is synthetic and small; it is a regression benchmark, not a legal dataset.
Metrics measure agreement with synthetic annotations, not legal correctness or enforceability.
Mock mode is deterministic and intended for CI; it does not measure live model quality.
Live mode is optional and depends on external model availability and credentials.
notice: Benchmark results compare synthetic annotations. They do not establish legal correctness and must not be presented as legal advice.
